Wood, Lorain and Butler County Boards of Elections: certified candidate lists for 3 November 2026
Statehouse News Bureau (WOSU, WYSU, WVXU, Ideastream), Signal Ohio and the Ohio Capital Journal: the 2026 race
Associated Press, Reuters, NPR, Christian Science Monitor, Newsweek, WCPO, WKRC, News5 Cleveland, Spectrum News
FactCheck.org (9 Sep 2026) and PolitiFact (2026) on the candidates' advertising
Pollsters' releases: CNN/SSRS, New York Times/Siena, YouGov, Marist, Suffolk, co/efficient, InsiderAdvantage, Fox News (Beacon/Shaw) and others; RealClearPolling, 270toWin and FiftyPlusOne averages
Congressional Directory (117th Congress); Senator Husted's official biography; candidates' campaign websites
Kyle Kondik, The Bellwether: Why Ohio Picks the President (Ohio University Press, 2016); NPR, 23 March 2024
Pew Research Center, Religious Landscape Study 2023–24; Ohio Department of Development population snapshot
U.S. Census Bureau Gazetteer; Natural Earth: state and country boundaries
